description:
The Sea Ray 420 Sun dancer is a luxury express cruiser designed for comfort, performance, and sleek styling. It’s a popular model among weekend boaters and coastal cruisers, combining elegant design with practical amenities for entertaining and extended stays on the water.

The cabin is designed for luxury and convenience, with high-end finishes and plenty of natural light.
